name: श्री रामचन्द्र कृपालु भज मन Rama Aarti — Sri Ram Chandra Kripalu Bhaj Man
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Tulsidas’s immortal stuti — the heart’s aarti of compassionate Rama.

name: जय काली माता Kali Maa Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Popular aarti of Mother Kali sung at Kalighat and Kali temples.

name: सुखकर्ता दुखहर्ता Ganesha Aarti — Sukhkarta Dukhharta
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Maharashtra’s beloved Ganapati aarti — now sung across India at the start of worship.

name: जय मनसा देवी Mansa Devi Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Aarti of Goddess Mansa Devi, beloved seat of Shakti in the Himalaya foothills.

name: आरती साईं बाबा Sai Baba Aarti — Ravi Vari Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Beloved Shirdi aarti of Sai Baba — ‘Rahaavi’ / evening aarti tradition.

name: ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी Devi Aarti — Om Jai Ambe Gauri
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. The classic aarti of Mother Amba–Gauri sung across North India.

name: ॐ जय लक्ष्मी माता Lakshmi Mata Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Classic aarti of Goddess Lakshmi — Om Jai Lakshmi Mata.

name: जय सरस्वती माता Saraswati Mata Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Aarti of Mother Saraswati — goddess of learning, arts, and speech.

name: जय गायत्री माता Gayatri Mata Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Aarti of Mother Gayatri — embodiment of the sacred Gayatri mantra.

name: आरती कुंजबिहारी की Krishna Aarti — Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Beloved aarti of Kunjbihari — Krishna of the groves of Vrindavan.

name: ॐ जय जगदीश हरे Vishnu / Jagadish Aarti — Om Jai Jagdish Hare
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. The universal North Indian aarti of the Lord of the Universe — sung for Vishnu, Krishna, and Rama alike.

name: जय सत्यनारायण जी Satyanarayan Ji Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Aarti of Lord Satyanarayan — form of Vishnu worshipped in the popular vrat-katha tradition.

name: जय वैष्णो माता Vaishno Devi Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Aarti of Mata Vaishno Devi — Trikuta’s beloved Shakti seat.

name: ॐ जय गंगे माता Ganga Mata Aarti
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. Classic aarti of Mother Ganga — Om Jai Gange Mata.

name: ॐ जय शिव ओंकारा Shiva Aarti — Om Jai Shiv Omkara
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. The most widely sung aarti of Lord Shiva — praising him as Omkara, the three-eyed auspicious lord.

name: हरिवरासनम् Ayyappa Evening Hymn — Harivarasanam
famousFor: Complete traditional aarti. The serene Sanskrit hymn that closes the sanctum at Sabarimala — Ayyappa’s lullaby of surrender.

name: हनुमान चालीसा Hanuman Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. The most recited chalisa in the world — forty verses by Tulsidas on Hanuman’s strength, wisdom, and Rama-bhakti.

name: राम चालीसा Rama Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. Forty verses on Maryada Purushottam Rama — ideal king and refuge.

name: दुर्गा चालीसा Durga Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. Forty verses to Durga — the fierce compassionate mother who ends fear.

name: गणेश चालीसा Ganesha Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. Forty verses to the elephant-faced lord who removes vighna (obstacles).

name: शिव चालीसा Shiva Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. Forty verses in praise of Mahadev — destroyer of fear, giver of yoga and moksha.

name: विष्णु चालीसा Vishnu Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. Forty verses honouring Vishnu as protector of dharma and refuge of devotees.

name: कृष्ण चालीसा Krishna Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. Forty verses on Krishna’s leelas — from Gokul to Dwarka.

name: अय्यप्पा चालीसा Ayyappa Chalisa
famousFor: Complete traditional chalisa. A popular chalisa-style praise of Dharma Sastha Ayyappa for pilgrims on the path.

name: नवरात्रि व्रत कथा Navaratri Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. Nine nights of the Goddess — from Shailaputri to Siddhidatri — and the story of Durga’s victory over Mahishasura.

name: एकादशी व्रत कथा Ekadashi Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. The fortnightly vow dedicated to Vishnu — fasting, japa, and listening to the katha of Ekadashi Devi.

name: प्रदोष व्रत कथा Pradosh Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. The vow observed in the twilight hour sacred to Shiva, when darshan and aarti are especially fruitful.

name: जन्माष्टमी व्रत कथा Janmashtami Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. The birth story of Krishna in Mathura prison — and the vow devotees keep until midnight darshan.

name: गणेश चतुर्थी व्रत कथा Ganesh Chaturthi Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. How Parvati created Ganesha, and why Chaturthi became his day of worship.

name: राम नवमी व्रत कथा Ram Navami Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. The birth of Rama in Ayodhya and the vow of joy kept on Ram Navami.

name: हनुमान जयंती · मंगलवार व्रत कथा Hanuman Jayanti / Tuesday Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. The appearance of Hanuman and the simple Tuesday vow kept in his name.

name: अय्यप्पा मण्डल व्रत कथा Ayyappa Mandala Vrat Katha
famousFor: Complete traditional vrat katha. The 41-day vrata of black attire, abstinence, and ‘Swamiye Saranam Ayyappa’ before the hill darshan.

name: करवा चौथ व्रत कथा Karva Chauth Vrat Katha
famousFor: Original TirthaYatra retelling of the popular Karva Chauth vow-story themes for home listening — not a publisher’s copyrighted edition.

name: छठ व्रत कथा Chhath Vrat Katha
famousFor: Original TirthaYatra retelling of Chhath’s Surya–Chhathi Maiya vow themes for home and ghat learning.

name: सत्यनारायण व्रत कथा Satyanarayan Vrat Katha
famousFor: Original TirthaYatra condensed retelling of the widely loved Satyanarayan vow themes (truth, promise-keeping, gratitude). Not a verbatim copy of any commercial katha book.

name: हरतालिका तीज व्रत कथा Hartalika Teej Vrat Katha
famousFor: Original TirthaYatra retelling of Parvati Ji’s Teej tapasya themes for home devotion.

name: वट सावित्री व्रत कथा Vat Savitri Vrat Katha
famousFor: Original TirthaYatra retelling of the Savitri–Satyavan vow story for home reading.

name: महाशिवरात्रि व्रत कथा Maha Shivaratri Vrat Katha
famousFor: Original TirthaYatra retelling of major Shivaratri myth themes (Neelkanth, lingodbhava, devotion over sleep).

name: अहोई अष्टमी व्रत कथा Ahoi Ashtami Vrat Katha
famousFor: Original TirthaYatra retelling of the Ahoi Mata vow themes for children’s protection.
